title: domain.next_sequential_id
description: Next sequence value assigned in a numbering scope (BE-DM-34, 37, 38, 44). customer: 1 + max over all customers of the organization, soft-deleted included. invoice: 1 + max over the customer's invoices in the same billing entity, any status (assigned when an invoice is finalized). billing_entity_invoice: 1 + max over the billing entity's non-self-billed invoices whose status is finalized or voided (drafts holding a value are ignored; never reset by month). credit_note: 1 + max over the credit notes of the same invoice, any status. Empty scope: 1.

seq.description: The row's sequence value in the scope (customer sequential id, invoice sequential id, billing-entity sequential id or credit-note sequential id).

status.description: Invoice or credit-note status of the row (invoice/credit_note scopes).

other_scope.description: The row belongs to another scope: another organization (customer), another billing entity (invoice, billing_entity_invoice) or another invoice (credit_note).
